articles.summary: At Turing, my team and I have been on quite the roller coaster ride in our quest to revolutionize product development R&D through AI. I wish I could say it was a piece of cake – or in our case, a perfectly optimized ketchup recipe – but the truth is, it's been a journey with more twists and turns than a pretzel factory assembly line.
articles.title: What Is AI Formulation? A Practitioner's Guide | Turing Labs
